title: Design: QuickBooks settings show one row per category under Cost of Parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-15-09-settings-integrations-quickbooks.png, iwo-happy-10-10-quickbooks-one-row-per-category.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • In ShopView Accounts, directly under Cost of Parts and above Cost of Goods (tax), two group headers show: "Internal work orders" and "No Charge work orders".
  • Under each header one row per category is named after the category (General Internal, Warranty, Goodwill, Comeback and any added), each with the QuickBooks mark and an account picker.
  • Under the rows a note reads "Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders are credited to the income account of your Shop supplies item in Products And Services; nothing to map here."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11762 (Story 5, QuickBooks Online account mapping)

  • S5-R1: “Integrations > QuickBooks, ShopView Accounts, shows one row per category directly under Cost of Parts (above Cost of Goods (tax)), grouped under the headers "Internal work orders" and "No Charge work orders", each row named after its category and carrying the QuickBooks mark. A category the shop adds appears as a new empty row; an archived category keeps its row, greyed, with its mapping, and the row can still be remapped (a reopened work order still posts to its archived category, S12-E8). Under the rows a note reads "Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders are credited to the income account of your Shop supplies item in Products And Services; nothing to map here." Nothing is created in QuickBooks: the picker lists the location's existing expense accounts.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 0 · Turn it on" / "Happy flow v6", boards "09 Settings > Integrations > QuickBooks" (Flow 0 · Turn it on), "10 QuickBooks · one row per category" (Happy flow v6).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow0-15-09-settings-integrations-quickbooks.png
  • iwo-happy-10-10-quickbooks-one-row-per-category.png

The design's own words:

  • “Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders are credited to the income account of your Shop supplies item in Products And Services; nothing to map here.”

Difference: the design's headers read "Internal work orders · one row per category" and carry no QuickBooks mark: register IWO-D11, settled by S5-R1.
